cadenciador.descricao: Controls the line's sending pace to reduce the risk of being blocked for bursts. Messages above the pace are not refused: they wait in the queue and go out on their own in the next window. Every sending mode is included, including operator replies and bot messages.
cadenciador.indisponivel: Cadence is not yet available for this installation. The daily limit is still available.
cadenciador.ativarHint: The window starts at the first send and accepts up to the configured number of messages.
cadenciador.pausa: Pause when the window limit is reached
cadenciador.pausaHint: The pause starts when the window reaches its limit and replaces the rest of it.
cadenciador.valorInvalido: Enter a whole number greater than zero.
cadenciador.proximaJanela: Changes take effect from the next window. The current window or pause ends with the current values.
cadenciador.estadoIndisponivel: Could not read the cadence state right now. Reload the page in a moment.

cadenciador.semJanela: No window open: the next message opens a new window.
cadenciador.alteracaoPendente: The new values take effect in the next window.
